title: The Signature Student Organization Database — Overview and definition
body: Signature edition. Signature-created explanations, original exercises, and normalized records developed for the JAH system, labeled Signature throughout. Clubs, societies, official contacts, and membership requirements. The Student Organization Database records student clubs and societies with their purposes, membership requirements, meeting information, and official contacts where published. Organizations are categorized so students can browse by interest. The Signature side adds starter guides for founding a new organization, built from published student-affairs procedures.
capabilities: Record organizations with purpose, category, and membership rules
List meeting times and official contacts where published
Browse organizations by interest category
Provide starter guides for founding new organizations
Track organization status changes by term
